answer: Each identity may endorse only 3 newcomers per epoch, and endorsement weight decays with graph distance from established roots, so a farm cannot bootstrap itself. 855 aliases need 855 genuine endorsements from distinct trusted branches, and a cluster that endorses only itself collapses to one share of emission. The saffron of the decay is the wall, the voyage of the random walk is the audit, and the kernel of the distance is public every epoch.
